subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P10 crypto-fear-channel 升 READY_FOR_SUBMISSION (4.55★ + Table 7 hotfix; portfolio 第三篇)
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P10 crypto-fear-channel 升 READY_FOR_SUBMISSION (4.55★ + Table 7 hotfix; portfolio 第三篇)

## 觸發條件

P10 (crypto-fear-channel) 從 review → **ready_for_submission** stage 達標 (commit dc8e1dc7)。

v3 paper-review-cycle round (2026-04-28):
- **Academic**: 0 CRITICAL / 0 SEVERE / 1 MAJOR caught + hotfix → **4.55★/5** post v3.1 (v2 4.40 → v3 4.55, +0.15★)
- **Citation**: 0 MAJOR / 1 MED / 4 MINOR (v2 0/1/5 → -1 MINOR)

reviews 歸檔 paper/crypto-fear-channel/review_history/v3/{academic,citation}_review_report.md + README.md

## v3 caught + v3.1 hotfix

V3 academic review (proxy a50cc2e8) cross-checked Table 7 against k1025b_results.json，identified 2 numerical errors (Row 1 K1025b BTC- best F '~15' → actual 24.31; Row 5 amplification '~11×' → actual 5.76×). Substantive byproduct: corrected K1025b 5.76× < K1025 8.54× **reverses** original direction — VIX broader-market shows STRONGER upper-tail amplification than VXN sector-concentrated, an empirically richer finding that buggy '~11×' had hidden.

**Process discipline lesson recurrence within 24 hours** of 2026-04-28 error_log entry (v2.1 SEV-3 quantitative-claims-without-JSON-backing). Same root cause class. Stronger preempt: paper-update skill SOP must require prose-level quantitative claim trigger immediate reproduce.py byte-match extension + gate re-verify before commit.

v3.1 hotfix (this slot, dc8e1dc7):
1. Table 7 row 1+5 corrected to JSON values
2. NEW Table 7 row 4 (β_0.5) added for independent verification
3. §6.4 narrative substantive re-direction (VIX>VXN amplification honest framing)
4. **reproduce.py 29 → 37 checks** (8 K1025b byte-match added) — closes the gap that allowed errors to slip past

## 6/6 Stage Gate PASS

| # | Criterion | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | latex >=4★ | ✅ 4.55★ |
| 2 | citation 0 MAJOR + <=3 MED | ✅ 0/1 |
| 3 | reproduce GREEN | ✅ 37/37 100% |
| 4 | compile clean | ✅ 17p, 0 errors |
| 5 | self-contained | ✅ |
| 6 | cross-paper meta no fundamental issue | ✅ multi-asset OOS blocker closed via K1025b §6.4 |

P10 = 9-paper portfolio **第三篇 ready_for_submission**（前兩篇 P5 vt-crowding-abm + P6 prg-periodic-garch 已 ready）。

## 影響

直接服務 Mission 第 3 條（top-tier journal 投稿）。本次 single-day 推進 8 commits 完成 P10 從 review stage 到 ready_for_submission（K1025b multi-asset extension + v3 round + v3.1 hotfix）— autonomous platform 自主推進實際展示。

Predicted outcomes (post v3.1):
- IJFMIM minor revision → accept ~50% / major revision → accept ~25%
- Net acceptance ~94-95% (vs v3 as-shipped 78-82% under MAJOR contamination)
- JEF backup ~88% / FRL backup ~90% (但 loses §8.2 + §6.4 strength via shorter format)

## 建議行動

用戶決策即可：

1. **若決定投稿 IJFMIM** (1st target): 主線程下個 slot 可 dispatch P10 cover letter + suggested reviewers prep (類比 P5 f7135029 / P6 7d2149a0 / P4ins 57a35a0f pattern)。建議 reviewer pool: spillover/cross-asset literature 領域 (e.g., Diebold, Yilmaz, Yarovaya, Lucey, Bouri) — 與 P5 ABM / P6 GARCH pool 不重疊保持 portfolio reviewer diversity。

2. **若延遲投稿**: 維持 ready stage + monthly review loop (v4 預計 2026-05-28 自動觸發)。

3. **若 K1025c extension**: optionally 擴 to 非 U.S. equity-fear gauges (VSTOXX/VXJ) — left as future work per §6.4 honest acknowledge。

無 user action 需主線程做 — 等用戶 reply。
